description:
§14.8.10 (S456 review F1, PA-reproduced) — `CREATE POLICY p ON assets AS --xPERMISSIVE USING (true) /*
RESTRICTIVE --*/`: Postgres ends a `--` comment at `` OR `
` (scan.l `newline [
]`), so the database runs `AS PERMISSIVE USING (true)` — a policy ORed with `scrml_tenant_iso` that widens it to every tenant. The lexer read the comment through `
` and admitted it (rc=0 on f746ff43b). Now every `--` reader ends at the first `` / `
`, and a lone `` in a `--` comment (whose extent differs between Postgres and SQLite / MySQL) is charged.
rationale: §14.8.10: a `CREATE POLICY` on a tenant-scoped table is charged (kind permissive policy) unless it is explicitly `AS RESTRICTIVE`; fail-closed: a declaration the compiler cannot attribute is charged, never treated as safe.
